questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 7 and their product is 12. What is the sum of their reciprocals?
questions.solution:
Let, two numbers are x and y

Sum of these two numbers is 7

x + y = 7 -----(1)

The product of these two numbers is 12

xy = 12 -----(2)

Divide equation (1) by xy

x/xy + y/xy = 7/xy

1/y + 1/x = 7/12

∴ Sum of their reciprocals is 7/12

questions.question: How many multiples of 5 are there from 1 to 200 which are not multiples of 4?
questions.solution:
Multiples of 5 from 1 to 200 can be represented as 5n, where n is any natural numbers and 1 ≤ n ≤ 40

∴ Number of Multiples of 5 from 1 to 200 = 40

5n will be a multiple of 4 if n is a multiple of 4

Now, multiples of 4 from 1 to 40 can be represented as 4m, where m is any natural number and 1 ≤ m ≤ 10

∴ Number of multiples of 4 from 1 to 40 = 10

∴ Required number = 40 - 10 = 30

questions.question: Which of the following number is divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
A number will be divisible by 9 if the sum of the digits of the number is divisible by 9

Sum of digits of 234561 = 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 + 1 = 21, Not Divisible by 9

∴ 234561 is not divisible by 9

Sum of digits of 444123 = 4 + 4 + 4 + 1 + 2 + 3 = 18, Divisible by 9

∴ 444123 is divisible by 9

Sum of digits of 555231 = 5 + 5 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 21, Not Divisible by 9

∴ 555231 is not divisible by 9

Sum of digits of 65422 = 6 + 5 + 4 + 2 + 2 = 19, Not Divisible by 9

∴ 65422 is not divisible by 9

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days and A alone can do it in 30 days. B alone can do the work in how many days?
questions.solution:
A and B together can do a piece of work in 20 days

Part of work A and B can do in 1 day = 1/20

A alone can do the work in 30 days

Part of work A can do in 1 day = 1/30

∴ Part of work B alone can do in a day = 1/20 - 1/30 = 1/60

∴ B alone can do the work in 60 days

questions.question: If 2/5th of a cistern is filled in 6 minute, then what is the time needed to fill the remaining part?
questions.solution:
Given,

Part of cistern filled in 6 minutes = 2/5

Part of cistern filled in 1 minute = 2/30 = 1/15

∴ Total time required to fill the cistern = 15 minutes

Remaining part to be filled = 1 - 2/5 = 3/5

∴ Required time to fill the remaining part = 15 - 6 = 9 minutes

questions.question: A trader allows two successive discounts of 30% and 40% on selling an article. If he sells that article for Rs. 840, then what is the marked price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
Let, marked price = Rs. x

After two successive discounts of 30% and 40%

Selling price

= x × {1 - (30/100)}{1 - (40/100)}

= x × (0.70) × (0.60)

= 0.42x

Given,

Selling price = Rs. 840

∴ 0.42x = 840

⇒ x = 840/0.42 = 2000

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 1050. A shopkeeper gives a discount of 30% and still makes a profit of 40%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Short trick∶**

Cost price = 1050 × 0.7/1.4 = Rs. 525

**Detailed solution∶**

Marked price = Rs. 1050

Discount = 30%

∴ Selling price

= 1050 × (1 - 0.30)

= 1050 × 0.70 = 735

Given,

Profit percentage = 40%

We know,

Profit percentage = [(Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price] × 100

40 = [(735 - Cost Price)/Cost Price] × 100

⇒ 0.40 × Cost Price = 735 - Cost Price

⇒ 1.40 × Cost Price = 735

⇒ Cost Price = 525

questions.question: If chairs are bought at Rs. 1200 each and sold at Rs. 1500 each, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Cost price = Rs. 1200

Selling Price = Rs. 1500

∴ Profit percentage = [(Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price] × 100

= [(1500 - 1200)/1200] × 100 = (300/12)% = 25%

questions.question: If the ratio of the cost price and selling price of an article is 4: 5, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let,

Cost price = Rs. 4x

Selling Price = Rs. 5x

∴ Profit percentage = [(Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price] × 100

= [(5x - 4x)/4x] × 100 = (100/4)% = 25%

questions.question: In a school 55% of the students are girls. If number of boys is 360, then what is the total number of students in the school?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Number of Boys = 360

Percentage of girls = 55%

**FORMULA USED:**

Percentage of boys = 100 - Percentage of girls

**CALCULATION:**

Let,

Total number of students = x

∴ Percentage of Boys = 45%

∴ Number of boys = 0.45x

∴ 0.45x = 360

⇒ x = 360/0.45 = 800

Total number of students = 800

questions.question: If the price of a commodity is decreased by 40% and its consumption is increased by 30%, then what will be the percentage increase or decrease in the expenditure of the commodity?
questions.solution:
Let,

Price of 1 unit of the commodity = Rs. x

If Price is decreased by 40%

Price of 1 unit of the commodity becomes = Rs. (1 - 0.40) x = Rs. 0.60x

If consumption is increased by 30%,

1.30 numbers of units consumed in place of 1 unit

Price of 1.30 unit of the commodity becomes = Rs. (1.30 × 0.60x) = Rs. 0.78x

∴ Percentage decrease in expenditure = [(x - 0.78x)/x] × 100 = 0.22 × 100% = 22%

questions.question: Speed of a boat along the current and against the current is 16 km/hr and 10 km/hr respectively. What is the speed of the current?
questions.solution:
Let, Speed of the boat in still current = x km/h and Speed of the current = y km/h

Speed of boat along the current is 16 km/h

∴ x + y = 16 -----(1)

Speed of boat against the current is 10 km/h

∴ x - y = 10 -----(2)

(1) - (2)

x + y - x + y = 16 - 10

⇒ 2y = 6

⇒ y = 3 km/h

questions.question: If 200 meters long train takes 40 seconds to cross a pole, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the train?
questions.solution:
Speed = Distance covered/Time required

To cross a pole, the train has to cover a distance equal to its length.

∴ Distance covered = 200 m

Time taken = 40 seconds

∴ Speed = 200m/40s = (200/1000)/(40/3600) = 18 km/h

questions.question: A sum was invested on simple interest at a certain rate for 5 years. If the interest rate is increased by 2%, then the interest increases by Rs. 190. What is the sum (in Rs) invested?
questions.solution:
Simple interest = (P × r × t)/100

P = Principal

t = Time period

r = Rate of interest

Given,

t = 5 years

Let,

Principal = P

Rate of interest = r

Simple interest = (P × r × 5)/100 = Pr/20

After, increasing interest rate by 2% keeping amount of Principal and time fixed

Simple interest = [P × (r + 2) × 5]/100 = P(r + 2)/20

According to the question,

(Pr + 2P - Pr)/20 = 190

⇒ 2P = 20 × 190

⇒ P = 1900

questions.question: What is the percentage change in the sale of company B from year 2011 to 2012?
questions.solution:
Sale of company B in 2011 = 150 crores

Sale of company B in 2012 = 375 crores

Change in sale of company B from year 2011 to 2012 = 375 - 150

= 225 crores

∴ The required percentage = (225/150) × 100 = 150%
